page_title: CAD 1-4 VAL | Cadiz CF v Valencia 14/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The match has just finished.
90+8' 1 - 4 Diego Lopez (Valencia) latches on to a lovely pass and buries the ball into the middle of the goal.
90+6' Brian Ocampo (Cadiz) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Isidro Diaz de Mera saw the whole situation.

90+4' 1 - 3 What a GOAL! A quick turnover allows Javi Guerra (Valencia) to mount a one-man counter attack and ends with him scoring with a precise shot from mid range that easily beats the keeper. That makes it1:3.
90+4' Cadiz CF fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
90+1' A yellow-coloured card is received by Giorgi Mamardashvili (Valencia).
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
88' Javi Hernandez (Cadiz) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
87' Javi Hernandez (Cadiz) has tested the patience of referee Isidro Diaz de Mera and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
85' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Cadiz CF.
85' Cadiz CF enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
81' Chris Ramos (Cadiz) is adjudged offside.
81' Here comes a substitution. Gabriel Paulista is given a rest as he is replaced by Yarek Gasiorowski (Valencia).
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Fran Perez trots off the pitch and is replaced by Alberto Mari (Valencia).
79' Chris Ramos (Cadiz) meets a cross from the flank and pulls the trigger from the edge of the box, but the ball flies high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty.
75' Ruben Baraja prepares a substitution. Hugo Duro is replaced by Javi Guerra (Valencia).
73' 8:6 – the total goal attempt statistics.
68' The attendance for today's match is 18622.
66' The substitution is prepared. Thierry Correia (Valencia) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Sergi Canos.
66' A substitution has been made. Jose Gaya goes off and Jesus Vazquez (Valencia) comes on.
65' Sergio has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Lucas Pires (Cadiz) replacing Fali.
65' Substitution. Robert Navarro walks off the pitch and Brian Ocampo (Cadiz) comes on as a substitute.
65' Sergio has decided to substitute Iza Carcelen and he is replaced by Maximiliano Gomez (Cadiz).
64' Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) will miss the next game.
63' Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Isidro Diaz de Mera had an easy-decision to make.
63' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Valencia, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
57' Isidro Diaz de Mera shows a yellow card to Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) for his blatant foul.
57' Hugo Guillamon (Valencia) has tested the patience of referee Isidro Diaz de Mera and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
54' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Sergio Guardiola (Cadiz) comes onto the pitch for Rominigue Kouame.

52' 1 - 2 GOAL! Diego Lopez (Valencia) receives the ball after a swift counter attack. Still with some work to do, he weaves his way through the defence to score a wonderful goal from close range to make it 1:2.
50' Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires high and wide.
47' Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
47' The game is interrupted. Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+8' The end of the first half.
45+3' Jose Gaya (Valencia) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Isidro Diaz de Mera blows for a foul.
45' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
42' Javi Hernandez (Cadiz) stands over the resultant free kick from mid-range, but his shot goes just over the crossbar. It could have been a fantastic goal!
42' Cadiz CF have been awarded a free kick.
42' Robert Navarro (Cadiz) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the right side of the goal, but Giorgi Mamardashvili pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
39' Iza Carcelen (Cadiz) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
38' Iza Carcelen (Cadiz) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
34' Valencia failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
34' That's unlucky! Sergi Canos (Valencia) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
32' Valencia couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Conan Ledesma (Cadiz) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
30' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Luis Hernandez (Cadiz) was quite harsh and Isidro Diaz de Mera didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
25' Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
21' 1 - 1 Goal! Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) lashes the penalty into the bottom right corner, giving the keeper no chance.
21' Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
21' The Cadiz CF players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
18' Referee Isidro Diaz de Mera makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Cadiz CF. Let’s see what happens!
17' Surely that's handball by one of the Valencia players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
17' Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it fails to bother the goalkeeper as it hits the defensive wall.
17' Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) attempts to curl the ball over the defensive wall from the free kick, but his effort fails to reach the goal.
17' Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) unleashes a shot from a mid-range free kick that crashes into the defensive wall. The opposition's goalkeeper set it up perfectly.
17' Cadiz CF are awarded a mid-range free kick.
15' Fede San Emeterio has picked up an injury and is replaced by Gonzalo Escalante (Cadiz).
13' Fede San Emeterio (Cadiz) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
12' Flag goes up against Chris Ramos (Cadiz) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
10' Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) watches the cross all the way and heads at goal from near the penalty spot, but his effort flashes narrowly wide of the left post.
8' 0 - 1 Goal! Diego Lopez tees up Hugo Duro (Valencia) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to score low into the middle of the goal. 0:1.
6' Isidro Diaz de Mera interrupts the game. One of the players from Cadiz CF won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
2' A corner kick by Cadiz CF is thwarted by the well prepared Giorgi Mamardashvili (Valencia).
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Valencia will have the kick-off.
Isidro Diaz de Mera is introduced as the referee for today's match.
